# Every reference still: slug | buttons pressed from boot | environment for the harness | overrides.
# Buttons: u d l r = D-pad, a b x y, q w = L1 R1, 1 2 = L2 R2, s = START, e = SELECT, m = MENU.
# The main menu is reached by wrapping left from its first entry, so one sequence reaches the same
# entry whether or not Recents leads the row (it does at 1280x720): l = Settings, ll = Apps,
# lll = Games, llll = Favorites. Settings rows below Tasks are reached the same way, upward from the
# first row, because Bluetooth adds a row on some devices.
# Environment: GS_TRIGGER=1 starts in the Game Switcher, as after holding MENU in a game;
# BOXART_PROMPT=1 lets the one-time box-art prompt show.
# Overrides: device=buttons, for a device that reaches the same screen another way. At 1280x720
# Recents is on the main menu (its config sets `recentsEnabled`), so the MENU popup has no Recents row.
main-menu||
main-games|lll|
main-apps|ll|
main-settings|l|
main-popup|m|
main-popup-down|md|
games|llla|
games-row2|lllad|
system-popup|lllam|
game-list|lllaa|
game-list-down|lllaad|
game-list-grid|lllaae|
game-list-icons|lllaaee|
game-list-carousel|lllaaeee|
game-popup|lllaam|
game-config|lllaax|
boxart-prompt|lllaa|BOXART_PROMPT=1
favorites|lllla|
recents|mdda||trimui-smart-pro=a
search-keyboard|ma|
apps|lla|
apps-down|llad|
apps-popup|llam|
settings|la|
settings-bottom|lau|
settings-power|laa|
settings-theme-settings|lauuuuuua|
settings-sound|lauuuuua|
settings-additional|lauuuua|
settings-animation|lauuuuada|
settings-tasks|lauuua|
settings-about|lauua|
game-switcher||GS_TRIGGER=1
game-switcher-next|r|GS_TRIGGER=1
game-switcher-popup|m|GS_TRIGGER=1
